title: Item 20a · Finding a person: the top-bar search
subtitle: Missing — not planned. Rule §3.2 (v0.12): a search bar in the top bar on every screen “once at least one section has something to search”, searching every section, results as you type. That condition is met — Prospects, Camps and Black Belt each have their own search box, in three different words — but nothing plans the top-bar search. Color Belt's and Star's rosters have no search at all. The “/” shortcut (§3.6) is waiting for it. (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

columns.label: Today

items.caption: 1. The top bar: the school switch and your initials — no search.

columns.note: Each box searches only its own list. Color Belt's and Star's rosters have none. To find a family today you must first know which section they are in.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · one people search in the top bar

items.caption: 5. Option B: “Search people” in the top bar on every page. Typing “Ava” lists her everywhere, grouped by section — name, event and school only (no dates of birth, phones or money). A tap opens that person's summary in the section (items 9a / 9b); on the PC the “/” key jumps here (§3.6).

columns.note: Scope for Main: people only, across Color Belt, Star, Black Belt, Camps and Prospects (Prospects keep “Ava R.”); nothing private in the results, so Hide private details has nothing to hide; the in-list boxes stay for narrowing their own list. Picture 5 is drawn over the real page with sample people from the preview's fake data; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question: build the top-bar search?
A · Keep as today. + no work. − the rulebook promises a search nobody plans; to find a family you must know which section to open.
B · Recommended: build it (picture 5). A people search in the top bar across every section, results grouped by section, nothing private; the in-list boxes stay. + at the desk, one place to answer “is Ava registered / signed up?”; the rule becomes true. − a real build for Main (searching every section's people safely, the results list, the “/” key); it comes after the walkthrough's fixes.
C · Drop the rule: §3.2 is reworded so each list keeps its own search. + no build. − no way to find a person across sections; the Grandmaster has to remember where to look.
